wallet.title: ওয়ালেট
wallet.tonconnect_info:
TON নেটওয়ার্কে ওয়ালেট কীভাবে ব্যবহার করবেন:
1. একটি ওয়ালেট অ্যাপ ইনস্টল করুন — যেমন Tonkeeper বা Telegram-এ @wallet।
2. ওয়ালেট তৈরি করুন এবং আপনার সিক্রেট ফ্রেজ (২৪টি শব্দ) নিরাপদ জায়গায় রাখুন — কাউকে দেখাবেন না।
3. আপনার ওয়ালেটে TON কয়েন যোগ করুন (এক্সচেঞ্জ, P2P বা @wallet-এর মাধ্যমে)।
4. «Connect Wallet» চাপুন, আপনার ওয়ালেট বেছে নিন এবং সংযোগ নিশ্চিত করুন।
5. হয়ে গেছে — এখন আপনি জমা ও উত্তোলন করতে পারবেন।

এটি নিরাপদ: সংযোগ করলে আমরা আপনার তহবিলে প্রবেশাধিকার পাই না — শুধু ঠিকানা দেখি। টাকার নিয়ন্ত্রণ শুধু আপনার, এবং প্রতিটি ট্রান্সফার আপনি নিজেই আপনার ওয়ালেটে নিশ্চিত করেন।
wallet.deposit_info: Tap “Deposit” and confirm the transaction in your wallet — done. The address and comment are filled in automatically (~30 sec). Only you control the funds in your wallet — we have no access to them, it's safe.
wallet.withdraw_info: Minimum 0.5 TON. Up to 100 TON — automatic in ~1 minute. Above 100 TON — manual review within 24 hours.
wallet.need_deposit_first: Make a deposit from this wallet first, then you can link it
wallet.bonus_note: +100% bonus on every top-up — for bets, withdrawable once wagered.
wallet.bonus_wager_info:
Your sign-up gift and top-up bonus can be staked right away, but they become withdrawable only after wagering.

Wagering means bet turnover: the total of the bets you place. Winning and losing bets both count. Bets cancelled before settlement do not.

A top-up bonus needs turnover of 30× the bonus; the sign-up gift needs 40×.

Once the turnover is reached the hold is lifted and the money becomes ordinary — you can withdraw it. Withdraw sooner and the unwagered remainder of the bonus is forfeited.

bonus.title: Bonuses
bonus.free_spins_how: A free spin is a free bet: you pick the side, we pay the stake. Winnings are credited as bonus money — you can bet with it right away and withdraw it after ×{{mult}} wagering and your first top-up.
bonus.deposit_text: Top up your balance and get {{percent}}% on top as a bonus. The bonus is wagered with turnover of ×{{mult}}.
bonus.wager_deposit_needed: At least one top-up with real money is required — without it bonus money can't be withdrawn
bonus.referral_text: Invite friends and get {{rate}}% of their losses — straight to your main balance.
bonus.promo_spins_sub: Free bets of {{amount}} {{currency}} — tap to see the terms
bonus.promo_referral_sub: Earn a share of your invited friends' losses
bonus.rules_intro: Bonus money can be staked right away and withdrawn after wagering.
bonus.rules_free_spins: Free spins: {{total}} free bets of {{stake}} {{currency}}. You pick the side, we pay the stake. Free spin winnings are credited as bonus money and need turnover of ×{{mult}} the winnings.
bonus.rules_deposit: The +{{percent}}% top-up bonus needs turnover of ×{{mult}} the bonus.
bonus.rules_turnover: Wagering means bet turnover: the total of all your bets, winning and losing. Cancelled bets and the free spins themselves don't count.
bonus.rules_deposit_required: Bonus money becomes withdrawable once the turnover is reached AND you have at least one top-up with real money. This applies to all bonus money, including gifts received earlier. If the turnover is reached before that top-up, the wagered bonus doesn't expire — it waits for the top-up.
bonus.rules_expiry: Unused free spins and unwagered bonus expire {{days}} days after they are credited. Withdrawing your own money before wagering is complete forfeits the unwagered bonus.
bonus.wager_earned_cta: Top up your balance and it becomes withdrawable. Until then it won't expire.
bonus.wager_earned_cta_min: Top up at least {{min}} {{currency}} and it becomes withdrawable. Until then it won't expire.
bonus.wager_deposit_needed_min: A top-up of at least {{min}} {{currency}} with real money is required — without it bonus money can't be withdrawn
bonus.wallet_need_deposit: {{amount}} wagered — top up your balance to withdraw it
bonus.wallet_need_deposit_min: {{amount}} wagered — top up at least {{min}} {{currency}} to withdraw it
bonus.rules_deposit_required_min: Bonus money becomes withdrawable once the turnover is reached AND you have at least one top-up of {{min}} {{currency}} or more with real money. This applies to all bonus money, including gifts received earlier. If the turnover is reached before that top-up, the wagered bonus doesn't expire — it waits for the top-up.
